ios.desc:
Fit Records: The ultimate workout tracker, routine planner, and gym companion to help you crush your fitness goals.

Fit Records is designed for gym-goers and fitness enthusiasts looking for a tool to visualise their progress, stay motivated and crush their goals. Whether you're into strength training, bodyweight exercises, or time-based workouts, Fit Records provides all the tools to create, plan, and track your fitness journey effortlessly.

Fit Records offers personalized training plans tailored to your unique goals. Our advanced AI analyzes your input to match you with an ideal program, curated specifically for your needs. Prefer designing your own workouts? Fit Records gives you full flexibility: use our extensive exercise catalog or create custom exercises, then organize them into a plan that’s perfect for you.

WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
• “Great workout tracker - This app is amazing! I can easily create my exercises and workouts. Without any clutter, I can only focus on what I need and track my workouts and progress.” - fitjunge
• “Great app, simple to use, and exactly what I need. - I have used many workout tracking apps. But Fit Records is by far the most helpful. It is simple enough, yet productive and efficient. It shows you exactly what you need and allows you to customise your workouts perfectly. There are no distractions. Also the Apple Watch app is perfect when working out for easy recording.“ - Luigi DT
• “Best fitness app - This is the best fitness tracker that I have ever used. It is easy to track how your progressive weight overload over days, weeks, and even months to ensure that you are building muscle! For the price, you can’t beat it.” - MuslimPanda
• “Very useful - Thanks to this app I finally managed to track my “progressive overload”. Works perfect with the Apple Watch as well.” - Cihanmex

KEY FEATURES
• Custom Workouts: Build routines using your exercises or our catalog. Fit Records supports bodyweight, weights, cardio, and more, adapting to your fitness style
• Training Plans: Design full training plans tailored to your specific goals, and easily switch between plans as your fitness level improves
• Ready-Made Training Plans: Looking for inspiration or ready to change your routine? Access a variety of curated plans for muscle building, strength gain, fat loss, and more
• Superset Support: Structure your workouts with supersets for maximum efficiency
• Explore hundreds of exercises with high-quality, free videos designed to help you

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a customizable workout tracker for iOS

quotes.text:
Hello everyone, for some time I wanted to have an easy to use, modern workout tracker, with no default exercises or workouts in it. I wanted to be able to build my own library from scratch.

Then I've built Fit Records. The features briefly:

- Building your exercise/workout library
- Recording your training sessions
- A companion Apple Watch App
- Charts for your progress
- Activity Insights for your workout trends

Let me know what you think, and if you have any questions.
